domains.title: 01. Market Microstructure & Order Flow
domains.key_finding: Multi-level book depth imbalance has statistically significant predictive power for short-horizon mid-price jumps; Level 1 top-of-book is contaminated by spoofing noise.
domains.spot_swing_role: Confirms limit-order absorption at 4H/1D swing lows prior to triggering long spot entries.

domains.title: 02. Time-Series Momentum & Technical Rules
domains.key_finding: Single lookback moving averages suffer rapid alpha decay; higher-timeframe trend filters prevent whipsaws and preserve capital by holding cash in macro bear regimes.
domains.spot_swing_role: Primary trend engine. Enforces 100% cash/stablecoin allocation when higher-timeframe momentum is negative.

domains.title: 03. Systematic Factor Pricing (Liu-Tsyvinski)
domains.key_finding: Bitcoin carries the primary systemic market beta; returns exhibit fat-tailed positive skewness during bull expansions and downside volatility clustering during liquidations.
domains.spot_swing_role: Normalizes position risk against aggregate crypto market volatility; prevents over-allocation during volatility spikes.

domains.title: 04. On-Chain Structural Metrics
domains.key_finding: MVRV < 1.0 identifies generational macro accumulation; SOPR retests of 1.0 act as structural support during secular bull trends.
domains.spot_swing_role: Macro floor/ceiling filter to prevent buying into exhausted on-chain distribution regimes.

domains.title: 05. Alternative Data & Machine Learning Hurdles
domains.key_finding: Direct price regression models consistently overfit; directional classification conditioned on transaction cost hurdles preserves real-world alpha.
domains.spot_swing_role: Binary execution filter: signal magnitude must exceed 2x round-trip trading friction (fees + slippage + spread) before firing.

models.name: Multi-Timeframe Trend Following
models.indicators: MACD(12,26,9) 1H & Daily, Price Action Trailing Exit
models.logic: Long entry: 1H MACD line crosses above Signal ONLY when Daily MACD is positive. Exit: Trailing stop at prior 4H swing low or structural close below entry.
models.live_rule: 1D MACD must be Bullish to permit 1H long entries

models.name: Ensemble Donchian + Volatility Target
models.logic: Aggregates breakout signals across multiple lookback windows (5 to 360d). Position size scaled dynamically: Weight = Target_Vol (25%) / Realized_Vol.
models.live_rule: Scale position inversely to 20-Day Annualized Volatility

models.name: Volatility-Adaptive Multi-Horizon Trend
models.indicators: Multi-horizon MA, Multi-timeframe RSI, ATR Risk Trailing
models.logic: Trend identified across 8H MA slope + RSI momentum filter. Dynamic position sizing and stop placement pegged to multiples of 14-period ATR.
models.live_rule: Peg trailing stop distance to 2.5x 14-Period ATR

models.name: Funding Rate Exhaustion Gate
models.indicators: Perpetual Funding Rate Percentile, Annualized Basis
models.logic: Spot swing risk gate: When annualized perpetual funding rate exceeds +30% (extreme retail leverage), freeze new spot swing entries to avoid long liquidation cascades.
models.performance: Regime Protection: Filters out severe local market tops and leverage flushes
models.live_rule: Freeze new longs when Annualized Funding > +30.0%

models.name: Cost-Aware Alpha Hurdle Filter
models.indicators: Expected Return Model vs. Round-Trip Taker Fees & Slippage
models.logic: Execute long trades ONLY if expected forward return > (Taker Fee + Slippage + Spread + Margin Hurdle). Suppresses churn during flat ranges.
